title: How do I reset my password?
text: Open the sign-in page and click 'Forgot password'. Enter the email address on your account and we will send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes. If the email does not arrive, check your spam folder or contact support.

title: How do I change the email address on my account?
text: Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address and confirm it with the code we send to that address. Your old address stays active until the new one is confirmed.

title: How do I turn on two-factor authentication?
text: Go to Settings > Security and choose 'Enable two-factor authentication'. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app and enter the six-digit code to finish. Save the backup codes somewhere safe.

title: I lost my phone and cannot log in with two-factor authentication.
text: Use one of the backup codes you saved when you enabled two-factor authentication. If you have no backup codes, contact support from your account email; identity verification takes up to two business days.

title: Can I get a refund?
text: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refunded, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the billing period.

title: How do I cancel my subscription?
text: Go to Settings > Billing and click 'Cancel subscription'. You keep access to paid features until the end of the current billing period, and your data is kept for 90 days after that.

title: Where can I download my invoices?
text: All invoices are available under Settings > Billing > Invoices as PDF files. You can add a company name, address and VAT number before downloading.

title: Which payment methods do you accept?
text: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and bank transfer for annual plans. Prices are shown in USD, EUR, GBP and INR depending on your region.

title: My card payment failed. What should I do?
text: Check that the card has not expired and that your bank allows international online payments. You can update the card under Settings > Billing; we retry failed payments automatically after three days.

title: How do I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
text: Open Settings > Billing > Plan and choose a new plan. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated; downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing period.

title: How do I delete my account and data?
text: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Deletion is permanent after a 7-day grace period, during which you can restore the account by signing in.

title: Can I export all my data?
text: Yes. Settings > Data > Export creates a ZIP archive with your projects as JSON and your files in their original format. Large exports are emailed to you as a download link.

title: How long does shipping take?
text: Hardware orders ship within 2 business days. Standard delivery takes 3 to 7 business days within the EU and US and up to 14 days elsewhere. You receive a tracking number by email.

title: How do I return a device?
text: Devices can be returned within 30 days in their original packaging. Request a return label from Orders > Return, pack the device and drop it at any parcel point.

title: What does the warranty cover?
text: Devices come with a two-year warranty that covers manufacturing defects. It does not cover water damage, drops or unauthorised repairs.

title: Does the app work offline?
text: The mobile app works offline for projects you have opened recently. Changes are stored on the device and synced automatically when the connection returns.

title: What happens if two people edit the same file at once?
text: Edits are merged automatically when they touch different parts of the file. If they conflict, both versions are kept and the file shows a conflict banner so you can choose which one to keep.

title: How do I share a project with a colleague?
text: Open the project, click 'Share' and enter your colleague's email address. Choose viewer, commenter or editor access. Viewers do not need a paid seat.

title: How do I add more users to my team?
text: Team admins can add seats under Settings > Team > Seats. New seats are billed immediately at a prorated price for the rest of the billing period.

title: Do you support single sign-on (SSO)?
text: SSO with SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect is available on the Business and Enterprise plans. An admin can configure it under Settings > Security > SSO.

title: What happens when I reach my storage limit?
text: You can still view and download everything, but uploads are paused until you free up space or upgrade. We email the account owner when usage reaches 80% and 100%.

title: How do I create an API key?
text: Go to Settings > Developer > API keys and click 'New key'. The key is shown only once, so copy it immediately. Keys can be revoked at any time.

title: What are the API rate limits?
text: The API allows 100 requests per minute per key on paid plans and 20 per minute on the free plan. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

title: How do I change the app language?
text: Go to Settings > Preferences > Language. The interface is available in 20 languages; support replies are available in English, Spanish, French, German, Hindi and Japanese.

title: When is customer support available?
text: Chat and email support are available 24 hours a day on weekdays. On weekends we answer within 24 hours. Enterprise customers have a phone line available at all times.

title: Where is my data stored and is it encrypted?
text: Data is stored in EU or US data centres depending on your region. It is encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3 and at rest with AES-256. We never sell personal data.

title: Do you offer a student or non-profit discount?
text: Students and registered non-profits get 50% off any paid plan. Apply from Settings > Billing > Discounts with a university email address or registration document.

title: How do I stop email notifications?
text: Open Settings > Notifications and turn off the categories you do not want. Security and billing emails cannot be turned off.
